name: claudinho
description: Your Claude Code celebrates when your team scores: a toast with the scorer, a short celebration with the Claude mascot, and the score above your prompt. Follow a competition and pin your team with the claudinho CLI on your machine, then open any match's goals and cards with /claudinho match. Live data: ESPN. Not affiliated with FIFA, any confederation, league or club, or Anthropic.

toasts.title: Score toasts
toasts.description: Which goals, score changes and full times raise a toast: pinned, your pinned team's match (claudinho follow <alias> --team <name>); with no pin saved, the session's first goal, then one hint on how to pin, then no goal toasts. all, every live match of the competition you follow; off, none.

celebrate.title: Goal celebration
celebrate.description: On a goal for your team the toasts announce (or any goal under all of a match with no pinned side), and at full time on its win or draw, the band plays a short celebration; off plays nothing.

context.title: Prompt context
context.description: While a match is live, each prompt you send carries the live score for Claude to read; off sends nothing with your prompts.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the band, the toasts, the goal celebration and the match pane: en, es, pt or fr; auto follows CLAUDINHO_LANG, then LANG (es_MX.UTF-8 is es), else English. The terminal statusline and the live score for Claude stay English.
